pages.title: Food Goes Bad!
pages.text: In SteamCraft, food doesn't last forever. Every food item has a freshness that decreases over time. Watch the colour of your food — $(bold)white means fresh$(), $(bold)green means getting old$(), and $(bold)dark means expired$(). Expired food makes you feel sick!

pages.title: Effects of Eating Expired Food
pages.text: Eating expired food gives you less hunger and saturation — sometimes as little as a quarter of the normal amount. You may also get $(bold)Nausea$() and $(bold)Slowness$() depending on how old the food is. The older it is, the worse it gets.

pages.title: Different Foods, Different Lifespans
pages.text: Some foods last much longer than others. Honey lasts 60 days. Dried kelp lasts 30 days. Cooked meat only lasts 4 days. Raw meat is even shorter at 3 days. Cook or preserve your food to make it last!

pages.title: Food Goes Bad — Then Rots!
pages.text: When food expires it automatically turns into $(bold)Rotten Food$() inside your inventory. Rotten Food can't be eaten safely, but it isn't wasted — bring it to the $(bold)Recycler$() to turn it into $(bold)Biomass$(), which works like bonemeal for your crops!
